name: Chromolyx
manufacturer: Nightshade Pharmatech (denied) — suspected joint development with a rogue Lazarus Pharmaceuticals materials division
description: Chromolyx is engineered to target the biochemical interface layer between organic tissue and cybernetic augmentation — specifically the SNT-bonding proteins that allow chrome to communicate with the nervous system. Once introduced, it causes progressive interface layer breakdown: augments begin misfiring, sending incorrect signals, then lose coordination, then attempt autonomous function as their control signals become corrupted. A heavily augmented subject becomes their own worst enemy — their own chrome attacks them.
effects: augments begin misfiring within 20 minutes — involuntary activation, incorrect force calibration, sensory implant distortion
advanced chrome loses motor coordination — subjects with augmented limbs may find them acting against their will
weapons-grade augments may discharge or activate spontaneously
pain-suppression implants invert — amplifying sensation instead of blocking it
side_effects: subjects with minimal augmentation experience only mild symptoms — Chromolyx scales with augment load
chrome lockup during cascade can cause physical injury (broken bones from limb spasm, retinal damage from optical misfires)
full cascade in a heavily augmented subject is potentially lethal — augment-induced internal injury
subjects with military-grade chrome experience accelerated cascade — designed hardening protocols interact badly with the compound
permanent SNT-interface scarring in 40% of cases — reduced augment performance long-term
duration: 2-5 hours of active cascade; interface damage may be permanent
cultural_context: The great equalizer in a world where chrome means power. A the Gray Zone runner with a syringe of Chromolyx can bring down a corpo enforcer with Φ200,000 in augmentation — the more chrome they carry, the harder they fall. This has shifted tactical thinking across GLMZ: heavily augmented operators now run pre-mission biochem sweeps, and certain Tier 4 executives have reduced their augment load specifically because they're afraid of Chromolyx. The irony — chrome as vulnerability — is not lost on GLMZ's cultural commentators.
story_hooks: A corpo security chief with full military-grade augmentation is hit with Chromolyx during a routine sweep. Their own chrome nearly kills them before the cascade is stopped. Someone on the inside provided access — and the chief knows it.
A black-market Chromolyx batch has been engineered with a longer cascade window — 12 hours instead of 5. The supplier is testing a new formula and the test subjects are real operators in the field.

A the Gray Zone medic has developed a partial countermeasure — a compound that slows Chromolyx cascade enough to get a subject to a chrome surgeon. They're selling it quietly, but both Nightshade and Lazarus want the formula suppressed.
